column1: # Reduced measurements from the 2026-09-04 A100 evidence set.
# Extracted from runs[] in the retained JSON files; see DEMO.md Appendix D.
# not_run means the measurement was never attempted because the CPU run in the
# same invocation consumed the whole time budget. It is not an MPS failure.
# records of a width share one value. Values at width >= 1024 were corrected on
# 2026-09-05: the live log parser had undercounted four-digit readings. The
# corrected series is linear in width; the earlier "flat 606-922 MiB" reading
# Follow-up campaign 2026-09-04 (same host and commit; bundle sha256
#  - width 128 peak_gpu_mib re-measured at 50 ms sampling (231 samples vs 58)
#    and corrected from 664 to 722 MiB. The 200 ms sampler missed the peak of
#    that ~5 s invocation. Model value at width 128 is 721 MiB.
#  - crossover widths 26 and 28 MPS were measured separately
#    the CPU timeouts. Two independent replicates each
#    deliberately not averaged. GPU/host memory was not captured for these.
